sentences.text: Shri B.S. Dhakad, learned counsel for the applicant.
Shri Nirmal Sharma, learned Public Prosecutor  respondent/State.
Status report has been received from the concerning Magistrate on administrative side, which shall be kept in chamber.

Learned counsel for the applicant prays for withdrawal of fourth bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. in connection with Crime No.03/2021 registered at Police Station Pahargarh, District Morena for the offence under Section 420, 272, 273 of I.P.C. and section 51, 57, 59, 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act.
Accordingly, the present bail application stands dismissed as withdrawn.
Record of the trial Court be sent back immediately.
